battery.capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: no page states EV3/EV4 usable kWh. 81.4 x 74.0/77.4 (the 77.4 kWh E-GMP pack, EV Database 74.0 usable). Treat as approximate.

battery.chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: the EV3 (and EV4, same E-GMP 58.3/81.4 kWh packs) use NMC lithium-ion packs.

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: Kia UK: nominal 343 V (400 V E-GMP, also stated by Guide Auto and InsideEVs).

ac_max_kw.notes: Kia UK: 11 kW AC (230 V 16 A, European spec). No North American page states the onboard charger; assumed unchanged.

dc_max_kw.notes: Kia UK spec: 128 kW DC (page ties it to the 10-80 % time; Fastned lists 135 kW). UK spec; same pack in North America.

published_10_80_min.notes: Kia figure: about 31 minutes 10-80 % on a 350 kW charger (relayed; Kia UK says 31 min too).
